name: spec-driven
description: Authoring and evolution workflow for living specs and ADRs: keeps docs/specs the source of truth and docs/adr the immutable decision log.

interface.shortDescription: Living specs as source of truth, governed by immutable ADRs.
interface.longDescription: Spec Driven ships the authoring and evolution workflow for living specs and ADRs. It teaches agents to keep docs/specs as the current-state source of truth, record architecture decisions as immutable numbered ADRs in docs/adr, and run the change lifecycle (ADR then spec edit) when documented behavior changes.
capabilities: Author current-state living specs in docs/specs
Write architecture decision records with context, options, and consequences
Run the ADR-then-spec change lifecycle and supersede reversed decisions
Route spec and ADR authoring without overlapping artifact placement
interface.defaultPrompt: Record this change as an ADR and update the affected living spec.
